items: 【LED TV Stand】This television stands is specially equipped with LED light strips, which are available in 22 colors and 22 dynamic modes for adjustment. Control the LED lights via a manual key or a smartphone app. Enhance the gaming experience in the game room or audience atmosphere in the living room.

【Enough Storage Space】Featuring 2 tiers open shelves and 1 fabric drawer, this entertainment center provides generous storage space to organize and display your media equipment, gaming consoles, DVDs, PS5, Xbox and more. Keep your room tidy and clutter-free.

【Sturdy and Durable】Made of high quality particleboard, a sturdy metal frame and firm fabric drawers, this tv console is both stable and durable. Balanced adjustable feet and an anti-tip device ensure stability, even on uneven floors.

【Versatile Uses】this tv stand's elegant design seamlessly blends into living rooms, bedrooms, nurseries or hallway, providing additional storage. With the open shelves and fabric drawer, it can also serve as a dresser or a bench in the bedroom. You can explore its various uses.

【Easy to Assembe】With easy assembly tools and detailed operating instructions included, you'll have this multi-functional media center set up in no time. Overall dimensions: 46.1"W x 11.4"D x 19"H, suitable for 55 inch TV Size.
